propositions: rebar search returns full ticket bodies (description and all comments) by default, exhausting agent context; discovery should project only ticket_id, alias, title, ticket_type, status, priority, summary, and snippet
Search has no summary field in the event schema; summary must be derived from description, truncated to 240 characters, and normalized for whitespace
The --output flag is unrecognized and causes search to exit with code 2; valid values json|llm should be supported, with json as the default
Snippet extraction requires case-preserving bounded context around first matching free-text term, with predicate-only queries returning null snippets
--full flag must preserve legacy full TicketState JSON shape for migration; --full with --output llm should be rejected as incompatible
